title: 数理計画(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Mathematical Planning
keywords: Linear Programming 2.Simplex Method 3.Project Scheduling 4.Arrow Diagram 5.Scheduling Table
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn the linear programming and project scheduling. (2) Learn how to express conditions in mathematical formulas. (3) Learn the concept of optimization.
advice: This is a basic course for understanding mathematical planning. We will cover the following materials: 1. Linear Programming 2. Formulation 3. Simplex Method 4. Project Scheduling 5. Arrow Diagram 6. Scheduling Table 7. CPM Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class/on a regular basis.
books: Textbooks: Operations Research Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students of this course will need the following knowledge/skills: (1) Basic computer skills. (2) The units of “Integrated Math and Science for Engineering (Functions and Differentiation)” and “Integrated Math and Science for Engineering (Integration and Differential Equations)”. (3) The units of “Linear Algebra 1” and “Linear Algebra 2”.

activityGoals.body: Be able to discover linear programming problems in everyday life.
Be able to formulate discovered problems.
Be able to solve the formulated problems using the simplex method.
Be able to create a schedule for software development.

lessons.content: 2. Linear Programming 1 Understand the simplex method.
3. Linear Programming 2 Exercises on the simplex method.
4. Linear Programming 3 Understand the dual problem.
5. Linear Programming 4 Exercises on the dual problem.
6. Linear Programming 5 Exercises on the dual problem.
7. Project Scheduling 1 Understand overview of project scheduling.
9. Project Scheduling 3 Exercises on arrow diagrams.

11. Integrated learning Exercises on project scheduling
